text:
Sam: Quick sync — VertexHealth onboarding, renewal in ~45d. Need to lock prefetch + batching approach and flag any renewal risks. Can we align on who owns each item? :eyes:

Maya: Current onboarding status: infra smoke done, sample prompts validated, default model pinned to redwood/gpt-2.7b:quant, waiting on customer to provide user-id prefixes for prefetch. I'll own the customer ask.

Leo: Watchlist: rising token spend during test script, and 95th pct latency spikes when qps > 12. Recommend enabling a small streaming window for chat (immediate first-token) and 200ms prefetch TTL for common prefixes.

Jordan: Suggest capturing feedback with short post-onboard NPS + 3 quick questions about latency, relevance, and billing surprises. I'll draft the survey and the email.

onboard-bot: Reminder: VertexHealth onboarding milestone 'integration-test' due in 6 days.

Sam: Runbook sketch — testing steps to validate prefetch/batching before go-live:
```
1) Enable prefix prefetch on canary route (ttl=200ms)
2) Run load script: 150 users ramp over 5m, 10s think time
3) Observe: p99 latency <= 600ms, token QPS stable, cache hit rate >= 30%
4) If p99 > 600ms: reduce batch window, enable KV-cache warmup, or fall back to smaller model variant
5) Post-test: capture sample logs and annotate failing prompts in product-feedback board
```

Maya: I'll schedule an enablement call with their infra lead for Tuesday 10:30 PT. Also will include a quick checklist for them to provide the user-id prefixes and sample traffic matrix.

Leo: Metrics to stream into Console dashboards: per-route token cost, cache-hit ratio, p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate by status. Set alert: token cost delta >20% vs baseline.

Jordan: Draft email to customer for data ask:
"Hi team — to finalize prefetch we need: 1) top 100 prompt prefixes, 2) expected peak qps, 3) authentication scheme (token vs mTLS). Please reply by EOD Wed."

Sam: Cool. Maya, assign the customer ask + link survey. Leo, can you prepare the canary config snippet and paste it here?

Leo: Pasting canary snippet:
```
route: /chat/canary
model: redwood/gpt-2.7b:quant
batch_window_ms: 30
prefetch: {ttl_ms:200, max_entries:1000}
fallback: smaller-arch
```

Maya: :thumbsup: I'll update the onboarding checklist doc and ping when call is scheduled.

Jordan: I'll attach the survey draft to CS drive and link it in here once ready.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Priority: lock customer ask + run the canary before EOD Fri. We'll re-evaluate renewal risk if we see >15% cost increase during canary. :shipit:
